pages.title: Custom Christmas Shirts & Gifts Chicago | June's Tees
pages.meta: Custom Christmas shirts in Chicago: matching family Christmas tees, pajama-party shirts, photo socks, Santa sacks and personalized gifts. Order early.
pages.h1: Custom Christmas Shirts & Holiday Gifts in Chicago
pages.pitch: Matching family Christmas shirts, ugly-sweater-party tees, photo socks, personalized Santa sacks and gifts with a photo, printed in our Lakeview shop.
pages.heading: Start designing your Christmas shirts

p: Custom Christmas shirts are a family tradition in our shop. The most requested design puts the family name and the year under a Santa hat or a tree, in the same color for everyone from the baby to the grandparents, so the holiday photo and the video call look like one team. Families add a role on each shirt (Mom, Dad, Nana, Elf in Training) or a running joke from the year.

Matching pajama-party shirts, office holiday party tees, and "Christmas crew" shirts for friends' gift exchanges are just as popular. We print every size from onesies and toddler tees to 5XL, in Christmas red, green, black or white.

Beyond shirts, we print gifts that people keep: Santa sacks with a child's name, socks printed with family photos, custom gift wrap with a face on it, photo panels and canvases, totes, and hoodies with a name or a photo. For grandparents, a hoodie or blanket with every grandchild's photo is always a hit.
Teachers, coaches, staff and clients get logo hoodies, caps and totes as holiday gifts, and churches and nonprofits order shirts for holiday giveaways and toy drives.

Funny lines like "I'm So Good Santa Came Twice" for the adults, "Santa's Favorite" for the kids, the family's last name with "Christmas" and the year, a skyline of Chicago in the snow, or a photo from last year's holiday. If you want something nobody else has, send us the idea and our designer will draw it for you.

sections.h2: Holiday shirts for offices, teams and churches
p: Companies order holiday party shirts and ugly-sweater-style tees for the whole office, teams order Christmas practice shirts, and churches order shirts for Christmas programs, toy drives and community dinners. We print the same design in several colors so each department or group can have its own, and bulk orders get price breaks at 12, 24, 48 and 100 or more pieces.
Nonprofits running coat drives and holiday giveaways order volunteer shirts and banners together, so the whole event looks organized and easy to find.

sections.h2: Gifts for teachers, coaches and clients
p: Personalized gifts for the people who helped all year: a tote with a teacher's name, a hoodie with the team logo for the coach, a branded cap or tumbler for clients and staff. Order a set with one design and a different name on each, and we pack them ready to hand out.

We print on soft cotton and cotton blends in Christmas red, kelly green, forest, black, white and heather gray, from newborn onesies to adult 5XL, plus hoodies, crewnecks, long sleeves and kids' pajama-style tees. Glitter and metallic inks add sparkle to names and snowflakes.

sections.h2: Christmas in Chicago, made in Lakeview
p: Our shop is on North Lincoln Avenue in Lakeview, close to Lincoln Park, North Center, Roscoe Village, Ravenswood and Logan Square. Chicago families like seeing a proof before anything prints, picking up by appointment on the way to a holiday party, and working with one small team from the first idea to the finished shirts. If you are out of town, we ship to your door or straight to the relative hosting Christmas this year.

December is our busiest month. Order by mid-November for the best choice of colors and sizes, and no later than about four weeks before your party or trip; our standard turnaround is 7 to 14 business days after you approve the proof. Pick up at our Lakeview shop by appointment, or we ship anywhere in the US.

faq.q: When should I order custom Christmas shirts?
faq.a: Order by mid-November for the best selection, and at least four weeks before your event. Our turnaround is 7 to 14 business days after proof approval.

faq.q: Can you print our family photo on a Christmas shirt?
faq.a: Yes. Full-color DTF printing reproduces photos with no minimum, so one shirt or forty can carry the same family photo.

faq.q: Do you make matching shirts for the whole family?
faq.a: Yes, from onesies and toddler sizes to adult 5XL in the same color and design.

faq.q: Can I order personalized Christmas gifts besides shirts?
faq.a: Yes: Santa sacks, photo socks, totes, hoodies, photo panels and gift wrap. Tell us what you have in mind and we will quote it.

faq.q: Do you ship Christmas orders?
faq.a: Yes, anywhere in the US. Allow extra shipping time in December.

faq.q: Can you design it for me?
faq.a: Yes. Send the idea, names and photos and we design it and send a proof before printing.

faq.q: Can you make a different name on each Christmas shirt?
faq.a: Yes, one design with a different name or role on each shirt.

faq.q: Do you print on hoodies and long sleeves for winter?
faq.a: Yes, hoodies, crewnecks and long sleeves in every size.

faq.q: Can our company order holiday party shirts in bulk?
faq.a: Yes, with price breaks at 12, 24, 48 and 100 or more.

cta.p: Send us your idea, sizes and date and we will reply with a design and a price.

pages.title: Custom Valentine's Day Gifts Chicago | June's Tees
pages.meta: Custom Valentine's Day gifts in Chicago: personalized wine glasses and gift sets, couples paint kits, matching shirts and photo gifts. Order early.
pages.pitch: Personalized wine glasses and gift sets, couples paint-and-sip kits, matching couples shirts and photo gifts, made in our Lakeview shop.
pages.heading: Design a Valentine's shirt or gift

p: Custom Valentine's Day gifts feel personal because they are: a wine glass with "Be Mine" and their name, a wine bag and glass set wrapped with roses, a wooden wine gift box with an inside joke on the front, or a photo panel of the two of you. We make each one to order in our Lakeview, Chicago shop, so it says exactly what you want it to say.
Gift sets for Galentine's Day, for the whole friend group or for coworkers, are just as popular: matching glasses or tumblers with each name, ready to hand out.

Our couples paint kits come with pre-drawn canvases that fit together (King and Queen, a lock and key, roses and a toast), brushes, paint and matching glasses, so date night at home becomes a painting party. They make a gift and an activity in one, and we can personalize the canvases with names and a date.

Matching couples shirts ("Mr. and Mrs.", "His and Hers", or a design with your anniversary date), lips and heart designs, and Galentine's crew shirts for a girls' night out are all printed with no minimum. Add a photo, your names or a date, in red, pink, black or white.

For him, engraved flasks and stainless tumblers with his initials, a hoodie with a private joke or your photo, a couples paint kit for a night in, or a wine and glass gift set with his name. Matching "His" and "Hers" shirts for a Valentine's trip are always popular.

For her, a wine glass gift set with roses and her name, a glitter "Wifey" or "Bae" shirt, a photo panel or canvas of a favorite picture, a tumbler with her name, or a Galentine's set to share with her friends. Every piece is made to order, so it can say exactly what you would say.

Teachers order Valentine treat bags and shirts for classroom parties, and salons, restaurants and boutiques order Valentine's staff shirts, gift card sleeves and window decals. Small businesses use custom wine glasses and gift boxes as Valentine's promotions and raffle prizes.

Short lines work best: "Be Mine", "Cupid's Favorite", "Mine Forever", your names with a heart between them, the date you met, or a nickname only the two of you understand. On wine glasses and flutes, a first name and a small heart look elegant; on shirts, bold lettering and a photo make a statement.

sections.h2: How to order a Valentine's gift
p: Tell us who the gift is for, what you want it to say, and the date you need it. We suggest a design, send a proof you can change as many times as you need, then make it in our Lakeview shop. Gift sets can be wrapped and ready to hand over, and you can pick up by appointment or have it shipped to you or straight to them. Ordering early leaves room to add a second gift, like matching glasses for a Galentine's brunch.

From a dinner in Lincoln Park to a night in, a personalized gift makes the evening. Chicago customers pick up by appointment at our Lakeview shop, a short ride from Lincoln Park, North Center, Roscoe Village and Logan Square, so a last look at the finished gift is easy. Gifts can also ship anywhere in the US for long-distance couples.

Order by the end of January for the best timing; our standard turnaround is 7 to 14 business days after proof approval, and February 14 arrives quickly. Pick up at our Lakeview shop by appointment, or we ship.

faq.a: By the end of January. Turnaround is 7 to 14 business days after you approve the proof.

faq.q: Can you put names on wine glasses?
faq.a: Yes, names, dates and short messages on wine glasses, flutes, shot glasses and tumblers.

faq.q: What comes in a couples paint kit?
faq.a: Pre-drawn canvases, paint, brushes and a palette, with matching glasses when you choose the gift set.

faq.q: Can I order just one gift?
faq.a: Yes. There is no minimum on personalized gifts.

faq.q: Do you make Galentine's Day gifts for a group?
faq.a: Yes, matching glasses, tumblers or shirts with each friend's name.

faq.q: Can I add a photo?
faq.a: Yes, on shirts, photo panels and many gifts. Send the clearest photo you have.

faq.q: Do you make Valentine's gifts for men?
faq.a: Yes: engraved flasks, tumblers, hoodies, shirts and gift sets.

faq.q: Can you make classroom Valentine's shirts?
faq.a: Yes, for teachers and whole classes, in youth sizes.

faq.q: Can I get a gift box with a message?
faq.a: Yes, a wooden wine gift box printed with your message.

faq.q: Can you ship the gift directly to them?
faq.a: Yes, anywhere in the US, with your message inside.

faq.q: Can I see the design first?
faq.a: Yes, every order gets a proof before it is made.

cta.p: Tell us who it is for, what you want it to say and your date.

pages.title: Custom Mother's Day Gifts & Shirts Chicago | June's Tees
pages.meta: Custom Mother's Day gifts in Chicago: shirts with her name or her kids' names, photo shirts, mugs, totes and matching mom and grandma sets.
pages.h1: Custom Mother's Day Gifts & Shirts in Chicago
pages.pitch: Shirts with her kids' names, photo gifts, mugs, totes and matching mom and grandma sets, made in our Lakeview shop.
pages.heading: Design something for Mom

p: Custom Mother's Day gifts that get worn: a "Mom" shirt in gold glitter with her kids' names down the sleeve, a "Dance Mom", "Soccer Mom" or "Science Mom" shirt that celebrates what she does, a "Super Mom" design, or a photo shirt with all the grandchildren. Matching sets for mom, grandma and great-grandma make a beautiful family photo.
For moms-to-be, an ultrasound photo shirt ("Dear Mommy, I can't wait to meet you") is one of the most touching gifts we make.

Mugs with her title or a photo, totes for the farmers market, hoodies with her name, photo panels and canvases, and caps for the mom who coaches. Grandparents love a blanket or a canvas with every grandchild's photo. We can also put her favorite saying or a message from the kids on almost anything we print.

sections.h2: Gifts from a team, a class or a church
p: Teams, classrooms, daycares and churches order Mother's Day gifts for every mom: matching totes or mugs with a short message, or shirts for a Mother's Day brunch or service. Send us the list of names and we personalize each one.

sections.h2: Ideas for what to put on a Mother's Day shirt
p: Popular wording includes "Mama" with the year she became one, "Blessed Mama", "Mom Life", "Grandma Est. 2026" style designs, the kids' names in a heart, or a list of what she is to the family. For grandmothers, "Nana", "Gigi" or "Glam-ma" with every grandchild's name on the back is a favorite, and great-grandmothers love a four-generation photo shirt.

sections.h2: Matching family shirts for Mother's Day brunch
p: Families planning a Mother's Day brunch, church service or photo session order matching shirts for everyone: "Her Favorite Daughter", "Her Favorite Son", "Proud Grandkid" and a special shirt for the guest of honor. We print every size from toddler to 5XL in the same color.

sections.h2: Gifts for new moms and moms-to-be
p: A first Mother's Day deserves something special: a shirt with the baby's name and birth date, an ultrasound photo shirt for a mom-to-be, a matching mommy-and-me set with a onesie, or a blanket with the baby's first photos. We can match the colors to the nursery or the baby shower theme.

sections.h2: Why order from a local Chicago shop
p: Ordering from our Lakeview shop means you see a proof before anything is made, you can pick up by appointment instead of waiting on a delivery, and you work with a real person who can help with the design and the wording. We are a Black-owned, women-owned business and Mother's Day is one of our favorite seasons.

Send us her name, the names of the kids or grandkids, any photos and your date. We design it, send a proof you can change, and make it in our Lakeview shop. Pick up by appointment or we ship anywhere in the US, including straight to Mom if she lives out of town. For a whole family ordering matching shirts, one person can collect the sizes and we bag each shirt with a name.

We print with methods made to last: full-color DTF prints that stay bright through washing, embroidery that never fades, and sublimated mugs and blankets where the image becomes part of the material. A shirt with her kids' names or a blanket of family photos becomes something she keeps for years.

sections.h2: When to order for Mother's Day
p: Mother's Day is the second Sunday in May. Order by mid-April to be safe; our standard turnaround is 7 to 14 business days after proof approval. Pick up at our Lakeview shop by appointment, or we ship.

pages.title: Juneteenth Shirts Chicago | Black-Owned Shop | June's Tees
pages.meta: Custom Juneteenth shirts in Chicago from a Black-owned print shop: family and group sets, Greek organization shirts, kids' tees and celebration designs.
pages.pitch: Juneteenth shirts for families, festivals, churches and Greek organizations, designed and printed by a Black-owned, women-owned shop in Lakeview.
pages.heading: Design your Juneteenth shirt

p: Juneteenth shirts celebrate June 19, 1865, the day freedom reached Galveston, and the holiday we celebrate today. Our customers' favorite designs say "Juneteenth Is My Independence Day", "Since 1865" or "Free-ish Since 1865", carry the definition of the word, or use a portrait in red, gold and green. As a Black-owned shop, these designs mean something to us, and we love helping families and groups make their own.

sections.h2: Family, festival and church Juneteenth shirts
p: Family reunions and cookouts on Juneteenth weekend order matching shirts with the family name and the year; festivals, block parties and community organizations order event shirts with sponsors on the back; churches order shirts for Juneteenth services and celebrations. We print every size from toddler to 5XL.

Fraternities and sororities order Juneteenth shirts in their colors with their letters, for service projects, parades and step shows. We match colors closely and can add chapter names and line numbers.

sections.h2: Juneteenth festival and community event shirts
p: Block clubs, park districts, nonprofits and businesses hosting Juneteenth festivals order event shirts with the name, the date and sponsor logos on the back, plus volunteer shirts in a second color so helpers are easy to spot. We also print the banners, yard signs and step-and-repeat backdrops for the stage and the photo area.

Kids' Juneteenth shirts with bright colors and encouraging words ("Proud", "Free", "Brilliant") are perfect for school celebrations, camps and family cookouts. We print youth and toddler sizes and onesies in the same designs as the adults, so the whole family can match.

Many Juneteenth designs use red, black and green from the Pan-African flag, or the red, white and blue of the Juneteenth flag with its star and burst, created in 1997 to represent a new freedom for all African Americans. We are happy to help you choose a palette that fits your message and your event.

Companies and employee resource groups order Juneteenth shirts for volunteer days, heritage events and parade groups. We match your company colors, add your logo on the sleeve, and sort orders by team or location.

sections.h2: Designs we can create for you
p: Our designer creates original Juneteenth artwork: portraits, typography, family crests, and designs that include your family name or your organization. Send us your ideas and we send a proof before printing.

Send us your design idea or choose one of ours, the colors, the sizes and your date. We send a proof you can change, then print in our Lakeview shop. Pick up by appointment or we ship anywhere in the US, which is handy for families traveling to a reunion in another state.

Juneteenth weekend is a favorite time for family reunions and cookouts. Reunion shirts that pair the family name with "Juneteenth" and the year, or a family tree in red, black and green, celebrate both freedom and family. We print every size from toddler to 5XL and can list each branch of the family on the back, so everyone sees their name.
Many families keep the design and order again each year with the new year on the front.
Order in May for the best timing; our standard turnaround is 7 to 14 business days after proof approval. Pick up at our Lakeview shop by appointment, or we ship anywhere in the US.

faq.a: In May. Turnaround is 7 to 14 business days after you approve the proof.

faq.a: Yes, June's Tees & Things is Black-owned and women-owned, in Lakeview, Chicago.

faq.a: Yes, with your family name and the year, in every size.

faq.q: Do you print for Greek organizations?
faq.a: Yes, in your colors with your letters, chapter and line details.

faq.a: No. Full-color DTF printing has no minimum; bigger orders get price breaks.

faq.a: Yes. Send the idea and we send a proof before printing.

faq.q: Can you print Juneteenth event shirts with sponsor logos?
faq.a: Yes, sponsors on the back and your event on the front.

faq.a: Yes, youth, toddler and onesies in the same designs.

faq.q: Can you match our company colors?
faq.a: Yes, and we can add your logo to the sleeve.

faq.q: Do you print banners and backdrops for Juneteenth events?
faq.a: Yes, banners, yard signs and step-and-repeat backdrops.

faq.a: Yes, anywhere in the US.

pages.title: Black History Month Shirts Chicago | June's Tees

pages.h1: Custom Black History Month Shirts in Chicago
pages.pitch: Empowering shirts for schools, churches, families and organizations, designed and printed by a Black-owned, women-owned shop in Lakeview.
pages.heading: Design your Black History Month shirt

p: Black History Month shirts celebrate pride, history and excellence. Popular designs carry words like "Talented, Kreative, Black", a map of Africa in red, gold and green, portraits, "Black King" and "Black Queen" designs, or the names of the leaders and inventors a school is studying. As a Black-owned shop, we design many of these ourselves and love creating something new with you.

sections.h2: Shirts for schools, churches and organizations
p: Schools order Black History Month shirts for every class and staff member, often with a theme for the month; churches order shirts for Black History programs; companies and employee groups order shirts for heritage events. We sort and bag by class or group, and bulk orders get price breaks at 12, 24, 48 and 100 or more.
Need a design that is yours alone? Our graphic designer creates custom artwork for programs, events and fundraisers, and we print it on shirts, hoodies, banners and posters so everything matches.

Many schools choose one design for the whole school with each class in its own color, or let each class design a shirt around a leader they studied. We print youth and adult sizes, sort and bag by class, and can add the school name and year. Teachers often order a staff shirt in a matching design.

Churches order shirts for Black History Month programs, youth presentations, choir performances and Sunday services, along with banners and programs for the event. A theme verse, the church name and the year make the shirts a keepsake for the congregation.

Employee resource groups and companies order Black History Month shirts for heritage events, volunteer days and lunch-and-learns. We match company colors, place the logo where it fits, and can print each team's name on the sleeve.

Words like "Excellence", "Legacy", "Unapologetically Black", "Melanin", "Black History Is American History" and "Dream Big" are popular, as are designs that honor inventors, authors, athletes and civil rights leaders. Our designer can build a design around your theme, your school or your family.

Many customers order heritage designs to wear all year, not just in February: family reunion shirts with African prints, Juneteenth shirts, and shirts celebrating HBCUs and Greek organizations. We are proud to be a Black-owned, women-owned Chicago print shop.

Send the theme, the design idea or the leaders you want to honor, the sizes and your date. Our designer sends a proof you can change, and we print in our Lakeview shop. Schools and churches can pay by invoice, and we sort and bag orders by class or group so handing them out takes minutes. Pick up by appointment or we ship anywhere in the US.

Black History Month programs often need more than shirts: posters of the leaders a class is studying, a banner for the stage, programs for the audience, and photo backdrops for families. Our graphic designer can create a matching set from one theme, and we print the banners, posters and shirts together so the program looks unified from the first slide to the final bow.
Order in early January for February events; our standard turnaround is 7 to 14 business days after proof approval. Pick up at our Lakeview shop by appointment, or we ship.

pages.title: Custom Halloween Shirts Chicago | Group Shirts | June's Tees
pages.meta: Custom Halloween shirts in Chicago: matching witch squad and family shirts, group costume tees, kids' shirts and party shirts. No minimum.
pages.pitch: Witch squad shirts, matching family and group costume tees, kids' Halloween shirts and party shirts, printed in our Lakeview shop.
pages.heading: Design your Halloween shirt

sections.h2: Witch squad and group Halloween shirts
p: Custom Halloween shirts are the easiest group costume there is. Witch squad sets give everyone their own witch (Good Witch, Bossy Witch, Quiet Witch, Crazy Witch, Little Witch), ghost designs like "I'm Just Here for the Boos" and "Boo Bees" are made for parties, and skeleton hands crop tops are a favorite for nights out. Send us the list of names or titles and we print one for each person.

Families order matching shirts for trick-or-treating, school parades and fall festivals, with a pumpkin, a ghost or a funny line for each person. We print youth and toddler sizes and onesies, and glow-style and metallic inks for something extra.
Bars, haunted houses, trunk-or-treats and office parties order staff and event shirts; teams order Halloween practice shirts. Bulk orders get price breaks at 12, 24, 48 and 100 or more.

Adults love Halloween shirts with a wink: "I'm Just Here for the Boos", "Stop Staring at My Boos", "Resting Witch Face", "Hocus Pocus I Need Coffee to Focus", or a skeleton hands crop top for a night out. Group sets with a different witch, ghost or monster for each friend make the easiest costume at any party.

Couples order matching pairs ("He's My Treat" and "She's My Trick", skeleton hands, a pumpkin and a seed), and families order a theme with a role for every person, like a witch coven, a ghost family or a haunted house crew. We print every size from onesies to 5XL so even the baby can match.

Schools, churches and park districts running trunk-or-treats, fall festivals and haunted houses order volunteer and staff shirts with the event name and date, plus banners and yard signs to point families in the right direction. Bulk pricing starts at 12 pieces.

Black, orange, charcoal and purple shirts are the Halloween favorites, and white or glow-style inks make designs pop at night. We print on tees, hoodies, crewnecks and crop tops, and on totes and pillowcase-style bags for trick-or-treating.

October is one of our busiest months for group orders. Ordering by late September gives you time to collect names and sizes, approve your proof, and still pick up with time to spare before parties start the weekend before Halloween.

Pick a design or send us your idea, then send the names or titles for each person and their sizes. We send a proof you can change and print in our Lakeview shop. Pick up by appointment or we ship. For groups, one person can collect everyone's choice and we bag each shirt with a name so handing them out at the party is easy.

Bars, restaurants, salons and boutiques order Halloween staff shirts to get into the spirit, and haunted houses and escape rooms order staff and scare-actor shirts in black with glow-style prints. Businesses also order Halloween window decals, yard signs and banners to bring in customers through October. Ask us for a quote on the whole set.
Order by late September or the first week of October; our standard turnaround is 7 to 14 business days after proof approval. Pick up at our Lakeview shop by appointment, or we ship.

pages.heading: Design something to sublimate

p: Sublimation printing turns ink into a gas with heat and pressure, and the gas bonds into polyester fibers and specially coated surfaces. Instead of sitting on top like a print, the image becomes part of the material, so it never cracks, peels or fades in the wash, and you cannot feel it. It reproduces photos and every color, edge to edge.

Photo collage and memorial blankets, mugs with a photo or a title, full-wrap tumblers, phone cases, pet bowls and mats, mouse pads, puzzles, keepsake plaques, ornaments and all-over-print polyester shirts and jerseys. If a blank is made for sublimation, we can usually print it; ask us about anything you have in mind.

sections.h2: Sublimation vs. DTF vs. screen printing
p: Sublimation is best for photos and all-over designs on white or light polyester and coated gifts. DTF (direct to film) is best for full-color designs on cotton and dark garments with no minimum. Screen printing is best for larger orders with a few colors, at the lowest price per shirt. We will recommend the right method for your design and your item.

Sublimated gifts are the heart of Mother's Day, Father's Day, Christmas, memorials and birthdays in our shop: a blanket of grandchildren's photos, a "Best Dad" mug, a tumbler with her name, a memorial blanket the family will keep. Send us your photos and we lay it out and send a proof.

All-over sublimated polyester shirts and jerseys carry a design from collar to hem and seam to seam, perfect for teams, events and brands that want a bold look. Because the ink is part of the fabric, the shirt stays breathable and soft, and the design survives seasons of games and washes.

Sublimation shows every detail of a photo, so use the largest, clearest version you have, ideally straight from the phone or camera rather than a screenshot. We adjust brightness, remove backgrounds and lay out collages for you, and the proof shows exactly how it will look.

A blanket made from a year of family photos, a mug with the grandkids' faces, a tumbler with a name in her favorite colors, a phone case with a pet's portrait, pet bowls with a name, a puzzle made from a vacation photo, or a memorial blanket for the family to keep. Sublimation is how we make most of the photo gifts in our shop, and every one starts with your photos and a proof.

sections.h2: Sublimation for businesses, schools and teams
p: Businesses order sublimated mugs, mouse pads, coasters and lanyards with their logo as client gifts and giveaways, and salons and restaurants use sublimated aprons and signs in their space. Schools and coaches order full-color jerseys, spirit towels and photo keepsakes for senior night, and families order matching photo gifts for reunions and memorials. Tell us how many you need and we will suggest the items that print best.

Our shop is in Lakeview, Chicago, near Lincoln Park, North Center, Roscoe Village, Ravenswood and Logan Square. Local customers pick up by appointment, and we ship sublimated gifts anywhere in the US. Because sublimation needs specific blanks, tell us what you want to make and we will confirm the best item, size and price before you order, with a proof of the design.
Most sublimation orders are ready in 7 to 14 business days after proof approval. Pick up at our Lakeview shop by appointment, or we ship anywhere in the US.

sections.h2: Trifold brochures that tell your whole story
p: Trifold brochures fit everything a customer needs to know into one sheet that slips into a pocket, a bag or a mail slot: what you do, your services and prices, a few photos and how to reach you. We print trifold brochures in full color on 8.5 by 11 inch 100 lb gloss paper, scored and folded into three panels that close to 3.67 by 8.5 inches, ready to hand out the day you pick them up.

A brochure printed on both sides uses all six panels: a cover, a back with your contact details and four panels inside for your services, menu, story or photos. Printed on one side only, the inside carries your message and the outside stays plain, which suits handouts and inserts. The price table above lists both at every run, with the price each and the total.

Salons and barbers with a service menu, restaurants and caterers with a take-away menu, churches with a welcome guide, schools and daycares with enrollment information, contractors and cleaners with their services and areas, nonprofits explaining their programs, real estate agents with a listing or a buyer's guide, and event planners with a schedule. A brochure on a counter keeps working after the conversation is over.

A good brochure leads with a strong cover, keeps each panel to one idea and ends with a clear way to contact you. Send a print-ready file and we check the panels and folds before printing, or let us design it: we write the layout around your services, place your photos and logo and send a proof of both sides. Brochure design is a separate fee shown on your quote, and nothing prints until you approve the proof.

sections.h2: Brochures with the rest of your marketing
p: Brochures pair well with product labels for your packaging, a table cover and an X-frame banner for events, and shirts for your staff. If you are getting ready for an opening or an event season, tick everything you need on the quote form below and we quote it together, with one design style across all of it.

Folded, a trifold has six panels. The front cover is what people see first, so give it your logo, a strong photo and one line that says what you do. The back panel usually carries your address, phone number, website and a map or QR code. The short inside flap is seen as soon as the brochure is opened, which makes it the place for an offer or your most popular service. The three inside panels opened flat work like one wide page for your full list of services, prices, menu or story. We lay out the panels and folds for you if you are not sure where everything goes.

Tell us how many brochures you need, one side or both, and when you need them. We reply with a written quote, usually within one business day. Once the quote is paid and the proof approved, your brochures go to print and are ready at our shop in the number of business days shown above the price table. We can ship your order straight to you or your event, or have it delivered to our Lakeview shop for you to pick up by appointment. Put the ship-to address in your message and shipping is added to your quote.
